market.note: Real market figures pulled via web search to give the dashboard a TAM/market-sizing anchor. Industry estimates vary widely by research firm and by how the category is scoped (US vs global, RTD vs incl. shots/mixes); treat as directional. Refresh periodically.
market.market_size_note: US energy drink retail sales ~ $21B (2024). Global estimates run far higher and vary by firm.
market.cagr_note: Commonly cited US forecasts cluster around ~7% CAGR (range across firms ~3-12%).
market.share_note: US dollar-sales share, Q2 2024. The 'All others' 23% is the realistic battleground for a new entrant.
